title: Adaptive radiation, incumbency and local ecological context drive dietary niches in New Guinean rodents
description: Analysis scripts, diet tables at all taxonomic levels (kingdom, phylum, class, order, family), and raw amplicon sequence variant (ASV) counts per individual supporting the study 'Adaptive radiation, incumbency and local ecological context drive dietary niches in New Guinean rodents'. Sequencing data are archived in the European Nucleotide Archive (project accession PRJEB121239).
